title: The Christian and Persecution
description: A lesson on why believers face persecution and how to respond in a Christ-like way.

cards.heading: Why Believers Are Persecuted
cards.scriptureText: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.
cards.body: Believers face persecution because even the Lord Jesus was persecuted. As His followers, we should not expect to be treated better than our Master.
cards.question: How does Jesus’ example help you understand persecution?

cards.heading: Children of Light in a Dark World
cards.scriptureText: You are the light of the world.
cards.body: The world often resists believers because light exposes darkness. Christians are called to shine in places where sin and unbelief are present.
cards.question: Have you ever experienced opposition because of your faith?

cards.heading: Sources of Persecution
cards.scriptureText: A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.
cards.body: Persecution may come from family members, mockers, false teachings, or even school and workplace environments where faith is ridiculed.
cards.question: Where do you most often feel pressure because of your faith?

cards.heading: Respond Through Prayer
cards.scriptureText: Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.
cards.body: Instead of retaliation, believers are called to respond with prayer, asking God to strengthen them and bless those who oppose them.
cards.question: How difficult is it for you to pray for those who hurt or oppose you?

cards.heading: Respond Through Love and Gentleness
cards.scriptureText: A gentle answer turns away wrath.
cards.body: A Christ-like response includes gentle words, love, and a steady testimony that reflects the character of Jesus.
cards.question: How can you respond more gently in difficult situations?

cards.heading: Remain Firm in Faith
cards.scriptureText: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult.
cards.body: Persecution is not a reason to turn away from God. Instead, it is a call to remain firm, patient, and faithful.
cards.question: What helps you stay strong when your faith is challenged?

cards.heading: Application: Count It as Blessing
cards.body: When believers suffer for Christ, they share in His sufferings and grow stronger in faith and dependence on God.
cards.question: How can suffering deepen your relationship with Christ?
